# Keybindings

## Window/stack management

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + J` | `cyclenext` |
| `Super + K` | `cyclenext prev` |
| `Super + Shift + J` | `swapnext` |
| `Super + Shift + K` | `swapnext prev` |
| `Super + Ctrl + Space` | `layoutmsg focusmaster` |
| `Super + Space` | `layoutmsg swapwithmaster` |
| `Super + Shift + Space` | `togglefloating` |
| `Super + Q` | `killactive` |
| `Super + F` | `fullscreen 0` |
| `Super + H` | `layoutmsg mfact -0.05` |
| `Super + L` | `layoutmsg mfact +0.05` |
| `Super + O` | `layoutmsg addmaster` |
| `Super + Shift + O` | `layoutmsg removemaster` |
| `Super + S` | `pin` |
| `Super + B` | `pkill -SIGUSR1 waybar` |

## Layouts (dwm-style glyphs published by hypr-layout)

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Super + T` | `hypr-layout tile` |
| `Super + Shift + T` | `hypr-layout bstack` |
| `Super + Y` | `hypr-layout spiral` |
| `Super + Shift + Y` | `hypr-layout dwindle` |
| `Super + U` | `hypr-layout deck` |
| `Super + Shift + U` | `fullscreen 1` |
| `Super + I` | `hypr-layout centered` |
| `Super + Shift + I` | `hypr-layout centered` |

## Volume

| --- | --- |
| `Super + Shift + M` | `wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle && barsig 10` |
| `Super + -` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 3%- && barsig 10` |
| `Super + Shift + -` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 10%- && barsig 10` |
| `Super + =` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 3%+ && barsig 10` |
| `Super + Shift + =` | `wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 10%+ && barsig 10` |
